en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a quiet, unpaved road bordered by a rocky hill on the left and a fence on the right. In the background, there is a large, old stone building with a steep, tiled roof and arched windows, likely a church or chapel. Two people, a woman and a child with a small cart, are walking away from the camera along the road. The scene is serene and rural, with some trees and a rustic atmosphere. There is no visible text on the image.
